/solutions/ai-infrastructure.title: Comino Liquid-Cooled GPU Servers & Workstations
/solutions/ai-infrastructure.description: Plan Comino GRANDO GPU servers and workstations in Taiwan, including workload sizing, power, cooling, manufacturer documents and procurement evidence.
highlights: Choose deskside or rack deployment from noise, available space, power, heat removal and sustained workload requirements.
The closed internal cooling loop transfers heat to the radiator; room ventilation and air conditioning still require review.
Review the selected GPU and CPU platform, memory, storage, software and inter-GPU communication as one system.
Confirm monitoring, quick disconnect procedures, warranty and power redundancy against the selected model and load.
Use the GRANDO Server v2.3 datasheet and RM v2.0.2 guide as technical references; conformity and test evidence must match the delivered configuration.

/solutions/social-intelligence.title: Cyabra Social Intelligence & Brand Protection
/solutions/social-intelligence.description: EudTech uses Cyabra to help communications, security and public-sector teams analyse inauthentic profiles, coordinated activity, narratives and brand risk.
highlights: Define the issue, relevant public sources, timeframe and decision owner.
Examine profiles, coordinated behaviour and narrative spread with reviewable evidence.
Agree the analysis output, licensing direction and pilot scope before implementation.

/about.title: About Eudaemonia Technology
/about.description: EudTech helps enterprises, researchers and public institutions plan PQC migration, AWS cloud, AI infrastructure and social intelligence delivery.
highlights: Requirements, sources, approvals, acceptance criteria and ownership are written down.
EudTech combines PQC migration advisory, cloud procurement, workload-led hardware planning and evidence-led intelligence.
Bring one concrete problem to identify the information and scope needed for the next step.

/contact.title: Contact EudTech
/contact.description: Discuss a PQC migration, AWS cloud service, GPU configuration or social intelligence need with EudTech. Start with your environment and intended outcome.
highlights: Send your question to quote@eudaemonia.tech or use the consultation form.
For PQC migration, include the systems, cryptographic dependencies, data lifetime and compliance requirements in scope.
For GPU systems, include software, workload, deployment location and available power and cooling.
For AWS services, include applications, expected usage, regions and your target launch date.
EudTech will propose the next step: discovery, a pilot, configuration review, a demonstration or a formal quote.

/privacy.title: Privacy & Data Use
/privacy.description: Learn how EudTech handles contact and quote data, customer-source attribution, retention, service providers and data requests.
highlights: Contact, company and configuration information is used to understand requests, prepare replies and maintain related business records.
Attribution may include campaign parameters, referrers and anonymous identifiers. Personal email addresses are not placed in public URLs.
Browser attribution data may be retained for up to 90 days. Customer-provided source information is kept separately.
Hosting, analytics, Microsoft 365, email and customer-record services support website operation and replies. Information is not sold.
Quote and business records are retained for service, contract, audit and legal needs, then deleted or de-identified when the purpose ends.
For access, correction, restriction or deletion requests, contact quote@eudaemonia.tech. The notice is effective from 16 August 2026.
